2609.30247.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
2609.30247.paper_summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.
2609.30247.paper_summary_zh: 世界行動模型（WAMs）將行動生成與未來視覺預測結合，用於機器人操作。然而，在每次重新規劃週期中完成聯合視頻-行動去噪過程會產生相當大的延遲，從而延遲行動更新並限制閉環響應能力。我們提出了Rolling-WAM，一種在連續重新規劃週期中分配聯合去噪的公式。 我們的方法保持一個在錯開噪聲水平下的視頻-行動片段的滑動窗口。在每一步中，滾動噪聲計劃完全去噪即將執行的行動片段，同時部分精煉更遠未來的片段。隨著窗口隨著新的相機觀察而前進，保留的未來片段繼續其去噪過程。這在時間上分配了計算成本，同時在片段邊界之間攜帶不斷演變的視覺-行動上下文。在LIBERO、RoboTwin和一個真實的Unitree G1人形機器人上的評估顯示，Rolling-WAM實現了具有競爭力的操作性能。通過消除從頭開始去噪整個預測範圍的需求，它在穩態重新規劃速度上比標準聯合WAMs提高了4.5倍。
